The '''Eib Model-D Cloudskiff''' was a cargo [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] in use on the planet of [[Tyed Kant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]

==Description==
[[File:Eib-model-d.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Model-D schematics.]]
The Eib Model-D featured an enclosed, pressurized pilot and passenger section, and as much cargo capacity as a small [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. The craft sacrificed speed in favor of the incredible altitudes it could attain. On planets where crime was a concern, some models had defensive weaponry. On [[Tyed Kant]], however, the volatile atmosphere made energy weapons more of a risk than any criminal, so the craft went unarmed.

==History==
The Eib Model-D was designed by [[Huegu Eib]], founder of [[Gryseium Incorporated]] on Tyed Kant. Gryseium was best known for its foodstuffs, but that did not stop the company from producing the Model-D, which was still in use long after Eib retired from Gryseium and left the planet. When the [[Mynock virus]] struck the planet an Eib Model-D was lent to a group of rebel agents who were investigating the crisis.
